sentences.text: A UCB is not required to offer borrowers a choice to switch to a fixed rate at the reset of floating interest rates, because the applicable UCB rule says it may, at its option, provide that choice as per its Board-approved policy.
The same UCB rule also treats the fixed-rate switch as one of the options that may be provided at reset, rather than as a mandatory offer.
A superseded 2025 reset circular also used permissive wording, stating that the bank may, at its option, offer the borrower a choice to switch to a fixed rate.
